decisions.reason: The superfood drink is far from the engineering core and has had no visible presence since 2018, so it falls below aspiration, and the firm would move its resources to the waste-to-energy core.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship that builds on the core business and is central to the firm's aspirations, and in a growing industry the firm has the R&D slack to keep carrying it despite little evidence of results.
The plastic-to-fuel plant fits the mission and is presented as a flagship, so the firm would keep it while its results remain uncertain, though its thin web presence raises the risk of a shortfall.
